stem: While resolving a claim, a Focalin prescription from a properly registered New Hampshire prescriber was issued four days ago and can be verified. Which conclusion is most defensible?

choices.text: Reject it because Massachusetts never accepts an out-of-state Schedule II prescription if its alternate trigger can be documented.
Apply the five-day contiguous-state narcotic rule because all Schedule II drugs are narcotics.
The nonnarcotic Schedule II out-of-state pathway may permit dispensing after verification.
Use the 30-day out-of-state Schedule III-through-VI window.
Dispense without verification because New Hampshire is contiguous.

Which conclusion is most defensible?'.
